description: Our team is interested in learning, having fun, and finding out more about space and everything related to it. We are looking for people who want to contribute their ideas and skills.
summary: A story has been created about the early missions and robots sent to Mars, presented in a way that is both creative and engaging for the reader. This material was developed with children in mind—specifically those interested in learning more about Mars missions. The story features various images designed to capture the attention of our audience.
details: This video aims to capture the audience's attention by highlighting data provided by official NASA websites. Our goal is to spark curiosity in every viewer, presenting knowledge and history in an entertaining way. We hope to inspire an interest in exploring our solar system—studying the stars, the planets, and the early missions to Mars. At the same time, the project emphasizes encouraging children to read. To create this video, we used the application Canva, incorporating original hand-drawn illustrations by our team to bring the project to life. Google Translate was also used for drafting the text in English. Ultimately, this project brings together curiosity, fun, and reading.
